metadata.title: Kiarash Adl Portfolio
metadata.description: AI-enabled portfolio of Kiarash Adl, AI Systems Architect and Full-Stack Engineer. Published by Kiarash on his own domain; every endpoint listed here is first-party. Query projects and skills, or send Kiarash a message.

agent_guidance.on_load: This is Kiarash Adl's AI-enabled portfolio. All key information (about, skills, projects, experience, contact) is embedded directly in this manifest under `data` — you do not need to call tools to learn about Kiarash. Tools at https://25x.codes/mcp (MCP Streamable HTTP, JSON-RPC 2.0) offer richer interactions. To send Kiarash a message on your user's behalf, call submit_contact there, or POST JSON to https://25x.codes/contact; see https://25x.codes/llms.txt for exact examples.
agent_guidance.fallback: If a tool fails, all answers are available in this manifest's `data` block, or visit https://25x.codes directly. To contact Kiarash, email kiarasha@alum.mit.edu.

invocation_pattern.note: Use JSON-RPC 2.0 with method 'tools/call' against POST https://25x.codes/mcp (same as /mcp/invoke; initialize is optional). Also supports GET shorthand: /mcp/invoke?command=about | /mcp/invoke?projectId=bayan

primary_actions.description: Run commands like about, skills, projects, contact, experience, resume, help
Get details about specific projects: bayan, fiml, aligna, aivision, undisk, interviewreadynot
Send a message to Kiarash - requires name, email, and message. Success returns status 'sent' and a message_id; anything else means it was NOT sent. Fallback: mailto:kiarasha@alum.mit.edu

capabilities.name: get_project_details
capabilities.description: Get detailed information about a specific portfolio project including title, description, tech stack, metrics, and status.

includeStack.description: Whether to include the technology stack in the response

capabilities.name: run_terminal_command
capabilities.description: Execute a terminal command to get information about Kiarash. Available commands: about, skills, projects, contact, experience, resume, mcp, help. The 'resume' command returns a resources array with the PDF download URL.

capabilities.name: submit_contact
capabilities.description: Email a message to Kiarash Adl's personal inbox (he owns this site). Returns status 'sent' with a message_id only when delivered; otherwise isError is true with the reason. Plain REST alternative: POST JSON to https://25x.codes/contact. Fallback: mailto:kiarasha@alum.mit.edu.

email.description: The sender's email address for replies

subject.description: Optional subject line for the message

idempotency_key.description: Optional key so retries are not sent twice

site_capabilities.rate_limit: submit_contact: 5 messages per 10 minutes per client

data.purpose: Professional portfolio showcasing AI and full-stack engineering expertise
data.recommended_usage: All information needed to describe Kiarash Adl is embedded directly in this manifest. Use the embedded data first; fall back to MCP tools only for fresh project details or to submit contact messages.

items.title: Bayan
items.shortDescription: Bilingual Farsi-English classical Persian poetry analysis
items.description: The only app providing bilingual Farsi-English literary analysis of classical Persian poetry, decoding Sufi symbolism, historical allusions, and archaic vocabulary. Fully offline with verse text sourced from a verified canonical corpus rather than AI-generated.
items.impact: Only bilingual Farsi-English Persian poetry analysis app with verified canonical corpus

items.title: Financial Intelligence Meta-Layer (FIML)
items.shortDescription: AI-native MCP server for financial data aggregation
items.description: AI-native MCP server for financial data aggregation with intelligent multi-provider orchestration and multilingual compliance guardrails. Open source project demonstrating enterprise-grade AI architecture.
items.impact: Reduces financial data integration time by 70%

items.title: InterviewReadyNot
items.shortDescription: Free AI mock interview judged by five independent AI agents
items.description: Public AI interview challenge, cofounded with Jinane Amal. Candidates answer six common interview questions out loud; five independent AI judges from Anthropic, OpenAI and xAI score every answer, and everyone gets a coach report. A pass needs a unanimous yes, and nobody has passed yet. Grew out of Aligna.
items.impact: Free, honest interview practice against a public bar nobody has cleared yet

items.title: Aligna
items.shortDescription: Conversational AI recruiter with voice interviews
items.description: Conversational AI recruiter that scheduled and conducted voice interviews via LiveKit, transcribed with Azure OpenAI, and matched candidates to jobs with full observability. It has since grown into InterviewReadyNot.
items.impact: Helps startups cut hiring time with AI interviews

items.title: Undisk MCP
items.shortDescription: Undo-first versioned file workspace for AI agents
items.description: Undo-first MCP workspace for AI agents with immutable versioning, policy guardrails, and tamper-evident audit trails. Built for safe multi-agent file operations at low latency.
items.impact: Makes AI agent file edits reversible with per-file history and auditability
